newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BUILDER TO PROPOSE CZK 3.5 GROSS DIV.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BUILDER TO PROPOSE CZK 3.5 GROSS DIV.

text.p: Czech construction firm IPS Praha a.s. said on Monday it would propose paying a 3.5 crown 1996 dividend for each share with a nominal value of 100 crowns.

The previous year, IPS did not pay a cash dividend, but instead paid a premium through a stock split, giving share holders 11 shares with a nominal value of 100 crowns for each original share which had a nominal value of 1,000 crowns.
"We will propose paying a 3.5 crown gross dividend," IPS Financial Director Miroslav Tvrdy told Reuters.
IPS posted an unconsolidated 1996 net profit of 79 million crowns, down from 168 million the previous year.
The firm will hold its annual general meeting on June 30, where the proposal will be voted on.
